Markus —

Pulled logs and ran a quick device-correlation pass. Highlights:
- 22 of 28 accounts share a near-identical device fingerprint and two matching TLS ClientHello JA3 hashes.
- 18 accounts created within a 9-minute window from 35.182.20.* (rotating proxy).
- 3 accounts have billing emails that match the company domain aeroscale.ai but are different subdomains (dev., staging., partners.). Those three show no prior charge history.

I've placed a soft hold on promo issuance via runtime config (no actual token grant will be issued). I can escalate to a stricter hold if we want to block API keys immediately.

I'll attach the full CSV in the shared drive link (see thread metadata). Recommend we ask AeroScale for a roster or confirmation email. If they provide event registration or an incipient pilot list, we can whitelist by exact email address string match.

-Priyom
